Input

Input components are used to collect user data. ZAKUIKit provides a wide variety of input types, sizes, states, and validation options.

Input Types

All standard HTML input types are supported with consistent styling.

HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter text">
<input type="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="you@example.com">
<input type="number" class="zak-input" placeholder="0">
<input type="tel" class="zak-input" placeholder="(555) 123-4567">
<input type="url" class="zak-input" placeholder="https://example.com">
<input type="search" class="zak-input" placeholder="Search...">
<input type="date" class="zak-input">
<input type="password" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter password">

Placeholder & Value

Inputs support placeholders and default values.

HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="This is a placeholder">
<input type="text" class="zak-input" value="Pre-filled value">

Disabled & Read-only

Disable or lock inputs to prevent user interaction.

HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Cannot type here" disabled>
<input type="text" class="zak-input" value="You can select but not edit" readonly>

Sizes

Three sizes are available: small, default, and large.

HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input-sm" placeholder="Small input">
<input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Default input">
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input-lg" placeholder="Large input">

With Icons

Embed icons inside inputs using the input group component.

HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/>
    </svg>
  </span>
  <input type="search" class="zak-input" placeholder="Search...">
</div>

Validation States

Show success, error, or warning states on inputs.

Input looks good!
This field has an error.
Please review this value.
HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-form-control-success" value="Valid input">
<span class="zak-form-text zak-text-success">Input looks good!</span>

<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-form-control-danger" value="Invalid">
<span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger">This field has an error.</span>

<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-form-control-warning" value="Check this">
<span class="zak-form-text zak-text-warning">Please review this value.</span>

Input Variants

Four visual variants are supported: filled, outlined, underline, and ghost. Apply one with .zak-input--filled, .zak-input--outlined, .zak-input--underline, .zak-input--ghost, or the attribute data-variant="filled".

HTML 
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input--filled" placeholder="Filled input">
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input--outlined" placeholder="Outlined input">
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input--underline" placeholder="Underline input">
<input type="text" class="zak-input zak-input--ghost" placeholder="Ghost input">

<!-- Or via attribute -->
<input type="text" class="zak-input" data-variant="filled" placeholder="Filled input">

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-inputBase input styling
.zak-input-smSmall size
.zak-input-lgLarge size
.zak-form-control-successSuccess state
.zak-form-control-dangerError state
.zak-form-control-warningWarning state

Accessibility

  • Every input must have a visible <label> associated via for/id.
  • Use placeholder only as a hint, never as a replacement for labels.
  • Set autocomplete attributes for common fields (email, name, password).
  • Disabled inputs should have aria-disabled="true" if they remain visible.
  • Use aria-describedby to link validation messages to inputs.
